literal: Darkness having departed, joy it will yield; delusion having departed, blemish-severed vision to them.
translation: For those of flawless vision who have freed themselves from delusion, the darkness of ignorance will depart and yield lasting joy.
modern: மயக்கம் நீங்கி குற்றமற்ற மெய்யறிவைப் பெற்றவர்களுக்கு, அறியாமை இருள் விலகி இன்பம் உண்டாகும்.
explanation: This couplet describes the reward of attaining true understanding. The word 'மருள்' refers to the delusion or confusion that clouds the mind, while 'மாசறு காட்சி' denotes a clear, flawless vision of reality. When a person achieves this state, the 'இருள்' or darkness of ignorance and suffering vanishes. In its place, this clarity of vision yields profound and lasting joy ('இன்பம் பயக்கும்').
